nodes.name: VIN_5V
nodes.semantic_role: External 5V power input rail for analog stage

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps down VIN_5V to VCC_3V3 rail. VIN pin receives VIN_5V, GND pin to common ground, VOUT provides digital supply. Requires input/output bypass capacitors. This module supplies VCC_3V3 to all digital and mixed-signal modules.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P microcontroller. Supplies VCC and AVCC pins with VCC_3V3. I2C pins PB6/SCL and PB7/SDA drive DAC on shared I2C bus. The MCU owns I2C bus biasing policy (pull-ups). Other digital pins are unused but must be tied to safe state. Common GND connections required for pins GND and GND_2.

nodes.name: dac_bias
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC. Powered by VCC_3V3, with common ground at VSS. SDA and SCL are I2C slave pins. A0 address pin is left floating for default I2C address. VOUT output provides a control voltage bias to the amplifier's non-inverting input network.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: opamp_preamp_ch1
nodes.description: NE5532 dual opamp, using only channel 1 as a non-inverting amplifier. Channel 2 unused: inputs IN2_P and IN2_N must be tied to a safe bias state (mid-supply via passive network), output OUT2 left open. VCC_P powered by VIN_5V, VCC_N powered by GND (negative rail). BIAS_VOLTAGE from DAC connects to IN1_P (non-inverting input) via a bias/control network. IN1_N (inverting) requires feedback/ground network for gain setting. OUT1 provides amplified audio output.
